description: Update links whose file changed on disk ("Verknuepfung aktualisieren"): link_ids[] (1 to 500) or, without it, every LINK_OUT_OF_DATE link. Ids that are not out of date come back as "nothing to do", no error. Returns results[] {link_id, name, page_name, status_before, status_after}, updated, failed and considered.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

link_ids.description: Links to update. Default: all out-of-date links.

name: update_links
title: Update out-of-date links
